items.descriptionAdvanced: Mukuni Royal Village represents one of the oldest historically documented villages of the Leya people in Zambia, whose origins date back to the 13th century. Well-established long before the arrival of European explorers in the region, it remains a living center for traditions and culture to this day. Under the continuous leadership of the Mukuni dynasty, the village serves as a spiritual and administrative base for the Leya community. As one of the most important cultural monuments near Victoria Falls, Mukuni offers a deep look into the unbroken continuity of traditional African governance and local power structures that have survived modern political influences.
